//: Installed plugins are copied into a version-pinned cache, so ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} has no path back to the checkout it came from - which is why this runs the published package rather than a relative script. That package carries stack.yaml and the sharded indexes, so the dependency lookups work on a machine that has never seen this repository. The documentation and authoring tools need the repository itself; open it in Claude Code and the .mcp.json at its root registers all eighteen.
